summary: OpenAI launched an Admin plugin for ChatGPT Work and Codex that lets workspace administrators review usage, manage members and permissions, and take supported admin actions from within a single conversation.

practices.reason: The plugin exposes Admin Console capabilities as permission-aware tools inside ChatGPT Work and Codex, which is a new interface admins could choose to install but nothing forces a migration.
practices.quote: It makes Admin Console capabilities available to ChatGPT Work and Codex as permission-aware tools, while honoring workspace policies and approval requirements.

practices.reason: The routing pattern of sending pending approvals to Slack/Teams and auto-granting access against predefined criteria is a concrete workflow design a team could imitate, but the reported gain is tied to OpenAI's own internal IT deployment.
practices.quote: It can also monitor feature-access requests and automatically grant access when they meet predefined criteria, while routing exceptions for review.
